name: io.github.julianmeyerr/steam-mcp-server
title: Steam MCP Server
description: Access Steam profiles, libraries, achievements, friends, news, and player statistics through MCP.

environmentVariables.name: STEAM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Steam Web API key for account-related tools.

environmentVariables.name: MY_STEAM_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default SteamID64 used when a tool does not receive one.

environmentVariables.name: STEAM_FAMILY_MEMBER_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated SteamID64 values for the family library.
